intent: A hedge maze of crumbling roofs and doubling-back paths: crawl corridors, roof runs, bramble dead-ends and a final climb to the raised terrace. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The formal garden gate
sections.lesson: Crouch the clipped corridor, hop the beds, trust the crumbling roof. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
The formal garden gate
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: The hedge maze
sections.lesson: The path doubles back above the fountain wall · look beneath the ivy. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
The hedge maze
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: The fountain courtyard
sections.lesson: Circle the fountain, then take the crumbling terrace walk high above it. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:

sections.name: The hidden overgrown garden
sections.lesson: Bramble dead-ends below · the rotting causeway rides above the garden. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

sections.name: The raised garden terrace
sections.lesson: Climb the gardener’s stair to the raised terrace and hold the line. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.
